[MUQATIL:76:23-24/r1] MUQATIL, d. 150 · author | holds | Muqatil returns to the earlier command that Muhammad be patient with God's judgment.
[MUQATIL:76:23-24/r2] MUQATIL, d. 150 · author | holds | Those urging Muhammad to disobey are the unbelievers who love worldly life and concern themselves only with possessions and material goods.
[MUQATIL:76:23-26/r2] MUQATIL, d. 150 · author | reports | At Dar al-Nadwa, al-Walid offered Muhammad half his wealth to abandon his message, Abu al-Bakhtari offered him a bride, and a third man claimed to protect him; Muhammad laughed, left, and revelation followed.
[MUQATIL:76:23-26/r3] MUQATIL, d. 150 · author | holds | The named sinner and unbeliever in the command are al-Walid ibn al-Mughira and Abu al-Bakhtari ibn Hisham; the source also associates the unbeliever label with Utba ibn Rabi'a.
